name: Fixture Essentials
description: Minimal baseline for the keleo-language validator fixtures. Deliberately generic and not a real methodology — it exists so new schema properties can be exercised before any authored document uses them.

focuses.name: Delivery
focuses.description: The work of producing and running something of value.

focuses.name: Direction
focuses.description: The work of deciding what is worth producing.

narrativeTypes.name: STAR
narrativeTypes.description: Situation, Task, Action, Result — a four-part narrative spine.

narrativeElements.name: Situation
narrativeElements.description: The context the work begins in.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Set the scene before describing intent.

narrativeElements.name: Task
narrativeElements.howToUse: State what success would look like.

narrativeElements.name: Action
narrativeElements.howToUse: Describe what was done, not what was planned.

alphas.name: Platform
alphas.description: The shared technical foundation on which the organisation's services run.

states.name: Identified
states.description: The need for a shared foundation is understood and agreed.

checklist.name: Need recorded
checklist.description: The platform need is written down and agreed by those who will fund it.

states.name: Available
states.description: The foundation exists and teams can use it.

checklist.name: Access granted
checklist.description: At least one team can reach the platform and deploy to it.

states.name: Operating
states.description: The foundation runs production workloads and is observed.

checklist.name: Health observed
checklist.description: Platform health is monitored and someone is accountable for it.

alphas.name: Service
alphas.description: Something the organisation offers that someone depends on.

states.name: Proposed
states.description: Someone has argued the service is worth offering.

checklist.name: Need articulated
checklist.description: The need the service meets is stated in terms of who has it.

states.name: Live
states.description: The service is available to the people it was built for.

checklist.name: Reachable
checklist.description: Intended users can reach the service unaided.

states.name: Depended On
states.description: Others have built on the service and would notice its absence.

checklist.name: Dependants known
checklist.description: Who depends on the service is recorded and they can be contacted.

activitySpaces.name: Build the Platform
activitySpaces.description: The work that brings the shared foundation into existence and keeps it running.

competencies.name: Engineering
competencies.description: Building and running technical systems that other people depend on.

levels.name: Assisting
levels.description: Contributes under direction and checks the result with someone else.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Does the work unaided and is trusted with production change.

levels.name: Proficient
levels.description: Handles unfamiliar problems in the domain without escalating.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Sets the approach others follow and is consulted on hard cases.

levels.name: Authority
levels.description: Shapes how the organisation as a whole does this work.

patternGroups.name: Core Lifecycles
patternGroups.description: The primary journey each practice contributes.
